title: Probe ordered into handling of rescuer's body after alleged disrespect
summary: An inquiry has been ordered into the transportation of the body of rescuer R. Rajesh. Ambulance drivers alleged that Rajesh's body was transported without a freezer facility and that there was a lack of respect during the process. The Hindu reported that a probe was ordered into the transportation of the body without a freezer facility. Mathrubhumi English reported outrage over alleged disrespect while transporting the body of rescue hero Rajesh.
summary_points: An inquiry has been ordered into the transportation of rescuer R. Rajesh's body.
Ambulance drivers alleged the body was transported without a freezer facility.
Drivers also alleged a lack of respect during the transportation of the body.
The Hindu reported the order for a probe into transportation without a freezer.
Mathrubhumi English reported outrage over alleged disrespect during transport.
